entities.name: Eva Maria Düringer Cavalli
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eva Maria Düringer Cavalli is an Austrian fashion designer and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Miss Austria 1977 and Miss Europe 1978/1977. She was also previously the co-creative director for Cavalli brands. Cavalli and her husband Roberto Cavalli divorced in 2010.
